name: adaptive-rag
title: Route a question, then grade the retrieval and the answer

origin.source: LangGraph Adaptive RAG tutorial (subsumes the Self-RAG tutorial)

comparison.purpose: Routes each question to a sample vector store or a sample web index, grades the retrieved documents, and checks the answer for hallucination and usefulness before returning it, with the routing and all three checks asked as Jev judgments rather than text generations. It also covers LangGraph's Self-RAG tutorial, which is the same graph without the router. LangGraph bounds the rewrite and regenerate cycles only with recursion_limit, which raises an error. Here MAX_REWRITES and MAX_REGENERATIONS are checked in choice states, and running out ends the run in a failed state that returns the last draft marked as unverified.
